message.content:
I'll search for information about altavista.com for you.

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>altavista.com history what happened to the website</query>

Based on my search, here's what I found about **AltaVista.com**:

AltaVista was one of the **first major search engines** on the web, launched in **1995** by Digital Equipment Corporation (DEC). It was revolutionary for its time, offering fast, comprehensive web search capabilities when the internet was still in its early commercial days.

## Key History:

- **1995**: Launched by DEC as a demonstration of their Alpha server technology
- **1998**: Acquired by Compaq when they bought DEC
- **1999**: Sold to CMGI
- **2003**: Acquired by **Overture Services** (formerly GoTo.com)
- **2003**: Yahoo! acquired Overture, bringing AltaVista under Yahoo's ownership

## What Happened:

Yahoo! **shut down AltaVista** on **July 8, 2013**. The site was discontinued as Yahoo consolidated its search operations and focused on its own search technology (which later became powered by Microsoft's Bing).

If you visit **altavista.com** today, it redirects to **Yahoo Search** or may not resolve at all, as the brand has been fully retired.

AltaVista is remembered as a pioneer that helped shape how people discovered information on the early web, though it ultimately couldn't compete with Google's rising dominance in the early 2000s.

---

Sources:
1. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AltaVista
2. https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2013/jul/02/altavista-search-engine-shuts-down-yahoo
3. https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-23143701
4. https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/altavista-dies-long-live-yahoo/
